constraints.source_text: A junior and senior recital must be completed under approved faculty supervision and guidance. The faculty of the department of the student's major program determines the detailed requirements of the recitals, including content, length, format, and other specifications. In cases in which a performance venue is required in order to present the recitals, reservations must be made according to the current guidelines of the Music Operations office.
constraints.description: Students must complete a junior and senior recital under faculty supervision, with requirements set by the department faculty.

unclassified.why: Overall total degree unit count has no dedicated family in the taxonomy; it is a summary total rather than a filter-measure-bound rule on a specific pool.

unclassified.source_text: During the junior and senior years of the program, students develop and fully realize unique individualized, mentored projects related to their work as classical musicians. This could involve developing a hybrid performance, conducting original research, exploring new creative technologies, or applying creative expression to a pressing social issue.
unclassified.why: Descriptive/explanatory content about the Young Artist Project content, already captured by the MUSC 480/481 course requirement; does not add a distinct enforceable constraint.
